name: external-template-library-decisions
body: External template library by path (v1) [with user decisions; autonomous choices flagged]. The deck's library path is stored in `kalide.yaml` under the top-level key `templates:` — chosen over `library:`/`templates-path:` because it reads naturally and collides with no existing key (title/author/date/theme/navigation/properties) [autonomous; confirmed with user]. Resolution rule: the configured path wins; else fall back to a local `templates/`; neither = error, no built-in fallback (preserving the project-templates no-fallback ethos); a configured path never silently falls back to a local dir [with user]. A relative path is resolved against the deck root for portability; absolute is allowed [autonomous, as recommended]. Exactly one library per deck: when both a configured path and a local `templates/` exist, the configured path wins and the local dir is ignored (not an error) [autonomous]. `kalide init <path>` points a new deck at an external library: it writes slides/, assets/ and kalide.yaml (with `templates: <path>`) but NOT a local `templates/`, and validates the library at path fail-fast BEFORE writing anything (reusing templates-dir-validation) [autonomous, as recommended]. RESOLVED feedback-1 [with user]: the path case writes NO starter slide and imposes NO template-name contract on the external library — a valid library needs only `library.yaml` plus the templates-dir-layout structure, and an empty library (no templates) is valid. This supersedes the earlier implication that path-init writes a fixed seed slide (which an arbitrary valid library need not define); the no-arg seed still writes the `hello` starter slide, while `kalide init <path>` leaves `slides/` empty and its AC only asserts the deck validates and serves from the resolved library. THEME CONTRACT (feedback-4) [with user]: a deck ALWAYS resolves a theme (optional, default `default`) against the resolved library, and an unresolvable theme is an error (theme-selection) — so a library that defines no matching theme is load-valid but cannot host that deck. `kalide init <path>` therefore validates the deck's theme against the external library BEFORE writing, and `kalide init-library` seeds a minimal `default` theme so the common create-then-point flow works out of the box. The init refuse-existing interaction was first decided autonomously (a path would still refuse on an existing local `templates/`) and then OVERRIDDEN [with user]: with a path, a pre-existing local `templates/` is exempt from the check (refuse only on slides/, assets/ or kalide.yaml; an existing `templates/` blocks only when no path is given) — see init-path-refuse-existing. The no-arg init seed is unchanged. The resolved root is used everywhere a local `templates/` was used: the template-library-loader is the single resolution point for start, the `kalide templates` gallery and live reload, and watch-deck / file-watcher watch the resolved root. Git/network is fully out of scope — kalide never clones or fetches and introduces no credentials or tokens (consistent with global.constraint.anonymous-install). This is the FIRST realization of global.constraint.template-library-shareable: the library stays a self-contained, relocatable unit and its layout is UNCHANGED (library.yaml, slides/, sections/, themes/, media/); only its root becomes resolvable from deck config. Amended requirements: external-template-library (new), project-templates, templates-dir-required, templates-dir-layout, templates-dir-validation, template-media, templates-gallery, cli-templates-list, theme-selection, deck-config, embedded-assets, requirements.constraint.deck-properties-unknown-keys, cli-init, cli-init-minimal-seed, cli-init-refuse-existing, templates-live-reload. Amended domain: domain.value.deck-config, domain.entity.template-library, domain.entity.template, domain.entity.theme, domain.entity.deck-changed, domain.value.media-asset, domain.value.library-manifest, domain.group.templating, domain.service.load-template-library, domain.service.watch-deck, domain.service.scaffold-deck. Amended solution: solution.component.template-library-loader, solution.component.file-watcher, solution.component.init-seed, solution.component.cli-commands, solution.component.template-registry, solution.component.theme-registry, solution.component.http-server.
